item.title: How to diversify your investments and avoid the most common traps - plus 18 fund tips
item.author: dailymail.co.uk
item.description: 'Broadly, the approach tilts towards cheaper "value" stocks and away from more expensive "growth" stocks.' 'Xtrackers S&P 500 Equal Weight UCITS ETF tracks the same number of holdings as a standard S&P 500 ETF but weights the components equally - at approximately 0.2 percent presently - rather than by size based on relative market capitalisations.' 'Holdings are rebalanced to equal weighting on a quarterly basis.'
